messages:
tess: FYI vendor ping from OpenAsteria about onboarding Asteria-Open weights into our marketplace. They sent a single-page distro policy with a few must-haves.
amar: Can you drop the key points here?
tess: Key excerpts pasted below:
```
- Redistribution: Model artifacts may be redistributed in compiled/quantized form only with preserved provenance metadata and checksum verification.
- Commercial hosting: Commercial hosted offerings require a separate commercial license; partner-hosted or BYOW permitted under standard listing.
- Appliance bundling: Hardware OEMs can bundle only after signing distinct HW redistributor agreement; OEM must present reseller contract & provenance attestation.
- Export & Compliance: No distributions to sanctioned countries; vendor to provide export-attestation form on demand.
```
kate: Ops/infra notes: we can add a SKU flag for "provenance_required" and store structured fields: original_hash, quant_recipe, build_tool_version. That will let us reject SKUs without metadata.
dave: Legal/Contracts: that commercial-hosting carve-out means our hosted product will need a clear UI disclaimer and maybe a toggle during checkout. Also need indemnity and warranty limits in the addendum.
contracts-bot: Action: generate partner_addendum_draft_v2 when @dave updates indemnity numbers. Upload to /legal/partners/ and request 48h review.
amar: Marketing asks about announcements: vendor wants coordinated launch but will embargo until we certify latency on Dedicated and include quantized performance numbers. Proposed announcement window = 2 weeks after go/no-go QA.
tess: Eng-ML: can you run a 5k prompt eval and provide perf numbers in 7 business days? We need sample prompts, privacy sweep, and edge-case hallucination checks.
kate: I'll add the metadata fields to SKU schema and a geofence field to prevent purchase in blocked regions. ETA 4 days.
dave: Confirmed we'll draft an addendum covering: commercial-hosting carve-out, checksum verification requirements, HW redistributor clause, export-attestation, indemnity cap. I'll circulate draft by EOD tomorrow.
amar: Also flagging royalties: vendor proposed revenue share on hosted usage, negotiable. Could affect pricing page.
tess: Suggested next steps: dave drafts addendum (24h), kate implements SKU metadata + geofence (4d), eng-ml run eval (7bd), amar & marketing prep announcement calendar (5d).
kate: :ok_hand: Sync standup tomorrow 9:30am PT to lock calendar and finalize draft.
